error[ZBX-E1007]: the virtual machine's size is out of range
  while  setting the virtual machine's size
  cause  --memory 64G is outside what this Mac allows: 512 MiB to 18432 MiB
  given  64G
  fix    give a size in range, for example:   zbx vm config --cpus 4 --memory 2G
         see the current values:              zbx vm config
  more   zbx explain E1007
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1007.html
